The maritime security company Ambrey said the vessel's group owner "is listed as Ray Car Carriers", whose parent company belongs to Abraham "Rami" Ungar, an Israeli businessperson.
Ray Car Carriers and its parent company, Ray Shipping, could not be immediately reached for comment outside business hours.
Japan's Nippon Yusen, also known as NYK, said the company had set up a taskforce to gather more information, including on the safety of the 25 crew, who were from the Philippines, Bulgaria, Ukraine, Romania and Mexico.
The vessel, a car carrier, had been heading towards India from Europe with no cargo, a spokesperson said.
